alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 29 at 12:55PM PDT until September 30 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected due to the combination
of high tides and elevated surf.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated surf of 2-4 feet on south and
southwest-beaches. Morning high tides are expected to peak
between 6.9 and 7.1 feet between 11 AM and noon on Wednesday.
